record.original_question: For coprime integers a and b, how many primes occur in each of the following sequences: (i) a p_n + b where p_n is the n-th prime, (ii) a^n + b with a not equal to -1, 0, or 1, and (iii) n^n + 1 and n^n - 1?

evidence.quote: How many primes do the following progressions contain:
a) { a·pn + b }, n = 1, 2, 3, ..., where (a, b) = 1 and pn is the n-th prime?
b) { a n + b }, n = 1, 2, 3, ..., where (a, b) = 1, and a is different from -1, 0, +1 ? c) { n n + 1 } and { n n - 1 }, n = 1, 2, 3, ... ?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Determine the number of primes (in particular, whether infinitely many primes occur) in each of the following three integer sequences:

(i) The sequence (a·p_n + b)_{n≥1}, where a and b are fixed coprime integers and p_n denotes the n-th prime number.

(ii) The sequence (a^n + b)_{n≥1}, where a and b are fixed coprime integers with a ∉ {-1, 0, 1}.

(iii) The two sequences (n^n + 1)_{n≥1} and (n^n − 1)_{n≥1}.

For each of these sequences, give an asymptotic count, or at minimum determine whether the sequence contains infinitely many primes.
artifact.status_search_result: These questions about primes in special sequences such as a·p_n+b, a^n+b (e.g. Mersenne-type and Fermat-type), and n^n±1 are classical and remain open. Even the special case of infinitely many Mersenne primes (2^n − 1) and the existence/infinitude of primes of the form n^n+1 are unresolved, and listed among long-standing prime conjectures.

status_evidence.title: Prime Conjectures and Open Questions
status_evidence.snippet: Lists of conjectures about primes in special forms, including Mersenne primes a^n-1 and similar exponential families, all considered open.
status_evidence.claim: The infinitude of primes in exponential sequences a^n+b (e.g. Mersenne primes) remains an open conjecture.

status_evidence.title: Landau's problems - Wikipedia
status_evidence.snippet: Problems about primes in special sequences such as n^2+1 remain unsolved; analogous questions for sequences like n^n±1 are also open.
status_evidence.claim: Questions about infinitude of primes of special polynomial/exponential form, including related sequences, are open.
